'''Exteen''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served both the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and later as an officer in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Exteen arrived on the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] homeworld of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in [[3643 BBY]] to take the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] the day the [[Search for the Fount of Rajivari|crisis]] surrounding the long-lost [[Fount of Rajivari]] ended. By the time the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] attacked Tython several months later, Exteen had become a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], and he flew a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] alongside other members of the Order in bombing runs against Angral's cruiser [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']] after the [[Hero of Tython|former apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] defeated Angral in [[Battle of the Oppressor|battle]].

After studying the exploits of military units such as the [[Republic Special Forces Division]]'s [[Havoc Squad]], Exteen was one of several Jedi who volunteered for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]]'s new program to integrate the Jedi Order and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] in the aftermath of the successful [[Battle of Corellia]] when [[Galactic War]] broke out with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Exteen soon achieved the rank of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] and became the commanding officer of the Republic cruiser ''[[Vanguard's Blade]]'', which participated in the [[Battle of Denova|second battle]] for control of the [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]]-laced [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Denova]].
